Hours of Operation

Last updated on October 7, 2026 9:51 am

View the hours of operation for our dining locations across the Forty Acres to plan your next visit. Whether you are looking for a meal, a boost between classes or something else to fuel your day, our dining locations are here to serve you. Check out our daily menus to see what we’re serving and our varied dining locations to find the option that best suits you. Select a current or future term from the dropdown menus below for the hours of operation.

Please note, hours may be subject to change.
